nodes.name: Webhook - Proposal Submitted
nodes.notes: responseMode is 'Using Respond to Webhook Node' — every path below must end at one of the two Respond nodes, or the portal's request will hang until timeout.

nodes.name: Prepare Send
nodes.notes: No AI, no template merge here — relays the mergedHtml/emailText the rep already approved in the portal preview, verbatim.

nodes.name: Generate PDF (CustomJS)
nodes.notes: Free HTML-to-PDF via CustomJS (e.customjs.io/html2pdf) — 600 free conversions/month, no server to run. Click in and add a 'Header Auth' credential (name it e.g. 'CustomJS API Key', header name x-api-key, value = your CustomJS API key) — never paste the key directly into this node or it ends up committed to the repo. continueOnFail is ON deliberately: if CustomJS is down or the free quota is used up, the next node falls back to the plain HTML email instead of breaking the send.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { test_mode: false, name: `TrueTel Cloud Phone Proposal — ${$json.client.companyName}`, subject: 'Please review and sign your TrueTel Cloud Phone proposal', message: `Hi ${$json.client.contactName || 'there'}, please review and sign your proposal below.`, text_tags: true, draft: false, files: [{ name: 'proposal.pdf', file_base64: $json.pdfBase64 }], recipients: [{ id: '1', name: $json.client.contactName || $json.client.companyName, email: $json.client.contactEmail }] } }}

nodes.name: SignWell - Send for Signature
nodes.notes: Click in and add a 'Header Auth' credential (name it 'SignWell API Key', header name X-Api-Key, value = your SignWell API key). Free plan: 25 API documents/month, no card required, sign up at signwell.com. Uses the same CustomJS-generated PDF as the fallback attachment — the Formal Acceptance section has invisible SignWell text tags (white, 1px) baked into it already, so this same PDF is what SignWell turns into a real signing session. continueOnFail is ON: if this fails, the next If node routes to the old raw-PDF-attachment fallback instead.

nodes.name: Gmail - Send Branded Proposal (Sign Link)
nodes.notes: Attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential after import. The email comes from TrueTel's own Gmail, not SignWell — the client never sees SignWell's name, just a 'Review & Sign' button.

parameters.message:

TrueTel Solutions Pty Ltd
1300 70 85 85

nodes.name: Gmail - Send Branded Proposal (PDF)
nodes.notes: Attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential after import. Only reached if SignWell failed or its free-tier quota is used up — falls back to the old Fill & Sign flow instead of blocking the send.

nodes.name: Gmail - Send Branded Proposal (Fallback, HTML)
nodes.notes: Attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential after import. Only reached if PDF generation failed or isn't configured yet — sends the full branded proposal as the email body instead, same as before PDF support existed.

nodes.name: Gmail - Send Quote Email
nodes.notes: Attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential after import.

nodes.name: GHL - Config
nodes.notes: Edit these 3 values directly here for a different pipeline or GHL account — find them via GHL: Settings > Pipelines, or the 'Find Pipeline, Stage, and Opportunity IDs' help article. Placeholders on purpose — real account IDs shouldn't sit in this public repo, even though they're not secrets the way the credential token is.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { locationId: $('GHL - Config').item.json.locationId, filters: [{ field: 'phone', operator: 'eq', value: $('Prepare Send').item.json.client.contactPhone }], pageLimit: 1 } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Search Contact by Phone
nodes.notes: Click in and add a 'Header Auth' credential (name it 'GHL Private Integration Token', header name Authorization, value 'Bearer <your token>'). Generate the token in GHL: Settings -> Private Integrations -> Create new Integration, with Contacts/Opportunities read+write scopes. Lookup priority per the team's request: phone first, then email, then create new.

nodes.name: GHL - Check Found by Phone
nodes.notes: Treats an empty client phone number as 'not found' regardless of what the API returns, so it always falls through to the email search.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { locationId: $('GHL - Config').item.json.locationId, filters: [{ field: 'email', operator: 'eq', value: $json.client.contactEmail }], pageLimit: 1 } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Search Contact by Email
nodes.notes: Only reached when the phone search found nothing (or the client had no phone captured). Uses the same GHL credential as the phone search.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { locationId: $('GHL - Config').item.json.locationId, email: $json.client.contactEmail, name: $json.client.contactName, companyName: $json.client.companyName, phone: $json.client.contactPhone || undefined, source: 'Proposal Builder' } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Create Contact
nodes.notes: Only reached when neither phone nor email matched an existing GHL contact.

nodes.name: GHL - Search Opportunity
nodes.notes: Uses the same GHL credential as the contact-search nodes above.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { pipelineId: $('GHL - Config').item.json.pipelineId, locationId: $('GHL - Config').item.json.locationId, name: `Cloud Phone — ${$json.client.companyName}`, status: 'open', contactId: $json.ghlContactId, monetaryValue: $json.pricing.totalIncGst } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Create Opportunity
nodes.notes: Only reached when this contact has no existing open opportunity in the configured pipeline.

nodes.name: GHL - Update Stage (Proposal Sent)
nodes.notes: Resolves the opportunity id from either branch above (found via search, or just created). Reads GHL_PROPOSAL_SENT_STAGE_ID from n8n env vars — get this id from GHL: Settings > Pipelines, or the 'Find Pipeline, Stage, and Opportunity IDs' article in GHL's help centre.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { body: `Cloud Phone proposal sent — $${$('Prepare Send').item.json.pricing.totalIncGst.toFixed(2)}/mo inc GST, ${$('Prepare Send').item.json.pricing.contractTermMonths}-month term. Sent via the Proposal Builder portal.` } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Add Note
nodes.notes: Text-only note (no PDF attachment) per team decision — the real PDF lives in the Gmail thread.

nodes.name: Multi-Site — FYI Notify?
nodes.notes: Fires AFTER the client already has their proposal — this is an FYI copy for visibility, not a hand-off. Nothing waits on a human here.

parameters.subject: =Multi-site proposal sent — {{ $('Prepare Send').item.json.client.companyName }}

nodes.name: Gmail - Notify BDM (FYI, Sent)
nodes.notes: Attach your Gmail OAuth2 credential after import. Falls back to admin@truetel.com.au if the submitting rep's own email wasn't captured.

nodes.name: Build Comparison + Scenario
nodes.notes: Handles standard AND multi-site the same way now — multi-site just adds site-count framing, it no longer branches off to a manual dead end.

nodes.name: OpenAI - Draft Narrative & Hero Stats
nodes.notes: Click in and select/create your OpenAI credential (Authentication is already 'Predefined Credential Type -> OpenAi API'). Model is 'gpt-4o-mini' in the Build AI Prompt node above.

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Validates + length-caps the AI output; falls back to deterministic bullets/stats if the model errors or returns bad JSON.

nodes.name: Merge Template
nodes.notes: Full branded HTML template embedded here (also saved standalone at templates/cloud-phone-proposal.html in the repo).

nodes.name: Build Plain Email Text
nodes.notes: Always builds both formats during generate, so the rep can toggle Email/Branded views in the preview without a second AI call.

nodes.name: Webhook - SignWell Completed
nodes.notes: SignWell has no dashboard page for this — the subscription was created directly via POST /api/v1/hooks with event_types: ['document_completed'] pointed at this URL. The 'Is Document Completed?' filter right after this one is a deliberate second check, in case that server-side event filter isn't actually enforced.

nodes.name: Parse SignWell Webhook
nodes.notes: Defensive field extraction — SignWell's exact completed-event payload wasn't verified against a real live webhook fire, only against their docs.

nodes.name: GHL - Config (Signature Webhook)
nodes.notes: This trigger runs independently of the main send path, so it needs its own copy of locationId — edit this placeholder the same way as the main 'GHL - Config' node.

nodes.name: SignWell - Get Completed PDF
nodes.notes: Uses the same SignWell credential as 'SignWell - Send for Signature'. audit_page defaults to true, so the IP-address/timestamp certificate is already baked into this PDF — no separate call needed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { locationId: $('GHL - Config (Signature Webhook)').item.json.locationId, filters: [{ field: 'email', operator: 'eq', value: $json.recipientEmail }], pageLimit: 1 } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Find Contact for Signed Doc
nodes.notes: Uses the same GHL credential as the main send path's GHL nodes. The contact should already exist from the original send — this just looks it up again by email since the webhook only tells us the signer's email, not the GHL contact id.

nodes.name: GHL - Check Contact for Signed Doc
GHL - Upload Signed PDF
nodes.notes: Uses the same GHL credential. Uploads to GHL's Media Library (location-wide, not tied to a contact) — the next node links the resulting URL onto the contact via a note.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { body: ($json.uploadedFileUrl ? `Signed proposal received and stored: ${$json.uploadedFileUrl}` : 'Signed proposal received (uploaded to GHL Media Library — see Payments > Documents & Contracts or Media Library).') } }}

nodes.name: GHL - Add Signed Doc Note
nodes.notes: Last step — no Respond node needed since the webhook already acked SignWell immediately (responseMode: onReceived).
